name: io.github.edouard-claude/gryzzly-mcp
title: Gryzzly
description: Gryzzly time tracking: log time in plain language, all 50 v1 API endpoints, one Rust binary.

environmentVariables.name: GRYZZLY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Gryzzly API key, from Administration → API keys

environmentVariables.name: GRYZZLY_USER_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Email of the person whose time is logged (or set GRYZZLY_USER_ID)

environmentVariables.name: GRYZZLY_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: UUID of the person whose time is logged
